chapter.verse: Dai dide-in Pasian bek ka ngak hi; keima kihotkhiatna ama tung pan hong pai hi.
Ka suangpi, ka kihotkhiatna, ka munkip muan’huai in amah bek hi a, kei ka kinak lin' kei ding hi.
Note khempeuh in, a hoi kawm, a kiliing gawl tawh a kibang mi khat, susia dingin bang tanvei hih huan ding na hi uh hiam?
Ama za-liatna panin sukniam ding bek amaute in sawm uh hi. Amaute in thuman lo-ah nuam sa uh hi. Amaute in a kam uh tawh phat uh a, ahih hangin a sungtawng uh-ah samsiat uh hi.
Ka lametna ama tung pan ahih manin, dai takin Pasian bek ka ngak hi.
Ka suangpi, ka kihotkhiatna, ka munkip muan’huai in amah bek hi a, kei ka kiling kei ding hi.
Keima suahtakna leh ka minphatna Pasian’ hang ahi hi; a muan’huai ka suangpi, ka bukna in Pasian ahi hi.
Mite aw, amah muang tawntung un; na lungkhamna teng uh ama tungah gen un; Pasian in eite’ bukna ahi hi.
Mineute ahih leh husan’ bang bek hi a, miliante pen a hawmpi ahi hi; tawikhaina-ah amaute in lek lo uh hi; amaute a kigawmin husan’ khat sangin zangzaw uh hi.
Zawhthawh thu tawh lakna muan’in, nei kei in la, suhgawpnate lamet-in nei kei in; na hauhna a khan’ leh, tuate muan’ in nei kei in.
Pasian in khatvei thu gen khin hi, ke’n hih thu nihvei za khin ing; vangliatna in Pasian’ neihsa ahi hi;
Topa aw, itna kip in nangma aa hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite ama sepna bangin na thukkik hi.
